name: RACL Geartech Limited
summary: RACL Geartech Limited manufactures and sells automotive components. The company offers pin gear T49; actuator shaft; assy diff, bevel gear FRT; balancer, clutch, output, and input shaft assembly; bearing fixed pin; counter balancer gear and shaft; driven pulley shaft; gear timing drive LH, EGR rear; gear wheel with spiral; journal; primary gear; rider foot peg comp RH; tab Ay driving gear timing drive RH; torque limiter assembly; and wheel gear with I.P. used for 2 wheelers.
